object_detection.name: object_detection
object_detection.description: On-device PPE (hard hat / high-vis) and number-plate detection for camera snapshots.

camera_apps.title: Camera Apps
camera_apps.description: App keys of the camera apps whose snapshots to analyse, e.g. 'doover_camera_1'. One instance can watch several cameras -- preferred over deploying one instance per camera, since each instance loads its own copy of the models into RAM.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Run hard-hat / high-vis detection on incoming snapshots.

require_hard_hat.title: Require Hard Hat
require_hard_hat.description: Flag a person who isn't wearing a hard hat.

require_highvis.title: Require High-Vis
require_highvis.description: Flag a person who isn't wearing a high-vis vest.

minimum_confidence.title: Minimum Confidence
minimum_confidence.description: Drop detections below this confidence (0-100). Lower catches more distant people but invents them: on a real site camera a traffic cone came back as a person at 0.49, which at the old default of 40 raised a violation.

notify_on_violation.title: Notify On Violation
notify_on_violation.description: Send a notification when someone is missing required PPE.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Detect and read vehicle number plates on incoming snapshots.

minimum_confidence.title: Minimum Confidence
minimum_confidence.description: Drop plate detections below this confidence (0-100).

minimum_plate_characters.title: Minimum Plate Characters
minimum_plate_characters.description: Discard OCR results shorter than this many characters. Guards against a partial read being published as a real plate.

notify_on_plate_read.title: Notify On Plate Read
notify_on_plate_read.description: Send a notification for every plate read. Off by default -- on a busy site this is a lot of notifications.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Run general object detection on incoming snapshots. Costs about as much CPU per frame as the PPE model, regardless of how many rules there are.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: What to look for. Every rule reads the same single model run.

name.title: Name
name.description: What to call this in the timeline and notifications, e.g. 'Cattle in laneway'.

objects.title: Objects
objects.description: Any of these counts towards the rule.

minimum_count.title: Minimum Count
minimum_count.description: How many of them must be in frame (and in a zone, if the camera has 'objects' zones) for the rule to trigger.

notify.title: Notify
notify.description: Send a notification when this rule triggers.

analyse_snapshots_because_of.title: Analyse Snapshots Because Of
analyse_snapshots_because_of.description: Only analyse snapshots captured for these reasons. Matches the 'reason' field the camera app publishes. Empty means analyse everything.

annotate_images.title: Annotate Images
annotate_images.description: Draw labelled boxes on the frame and publish it back to the camera's channel so the timeline shows what was flagged.

publish_results_with_no_findings.title: Publish Results With No Findings
publish_results_with_no_findings.description: Publish a result even when nothing was detected. Off by default so the camera timeline isn't filled with empty analyses.

inference_size.title: Inference Size
inference_size.description: Square size (px) frames are letterboxed to before inference. Larger catches smaller/more distant subjects but costs CPU time and RAM.

object_detection_processor.name: object_detection_processor
object_detection_processor.description: Cloud processor that runs PPE and number-plate inference on camera snapshots and edits the snapshot message in place with the result.

analyse_snapshots_because_of.title: Analyse Snapshots Because Of
analyse_snapshots_because_of.description: Only analyse snapshots captured for these reasons. Matches the 'reason' field the camera app publishes. Empty means analyse everything.

annotate_images.title: Annotate Images
annotate_images.description: Attach a copy of the frame with labelled boxes drawn on it.

match_detectors_to_event.title: Match Detectors To Event
match_detectors_to_event.description: Only run the detector the camera's classification calls for: PPE on a person event, plates on a vehicle event. Halves the inference per frame and removes false findings from the model that wasn't relevant (a traffic cone read as a person on a vehicle event, for instance). Unclassified snapshots (schedule, manual, intruder) still run everything, and general object detection runs on every event. Turn off to always run all of them -- worth doing if people arrive by vehicle and you need PPE checked on the vehicle event itself.

inference_size.title: Inference Size
inference_size.description: Square size (px) frames are letterboxed to before inference. Leave at 640 unless you have measured otherwise: raising it is NOT a free accuracy win. The weights are trained at 640, and on a real site frame 960 lost a person that 640 found (see the README). More CPU here buys throughput, not better detection.
